title: Asia stocks bounce on dip buying, bonds lag behind
title_zh: 亚洲股市逢低买盘反弹，债券落后
summary: By Wayne Cole SYDNEY, June 9 (Reuters) - Asian stock markets eked out a rally on Tuesday and oil prices came off highs after Israel and Iran said they would halt attacks on each other for now, while
summary_zh: 路透悉尼 6 月 9 日 - 以色列和伊朗表示暂时停止相互攻击后，亚洲股市周二小幅上涨，油价也从高位回落。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise as AI trade takes center stage
title_zh: 今日股市：人工智能交易成为焦点，道指、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货上涨
summary: US stock futures edged lower as the AI trade continued to take center stage on Wall Street.
summary_zh: 随着人工智能交易继续成为华尔街的中心舞台，美国股指期货小幅走低。

title: Apple pitches a more personal, easier-to-use AI
title_zh: 苹果推出更个性化、更易于使用的人工智能
summary: Apple's pitch for AI is about being personal and easy to use.
summary_zh: 苹果对人工智能的宣传是个性化且易于使用。

title: Meta funds skilled trades jobs program for AI data center buildout
title_zh: Meta 为人工智能数据中心建设的技术工人就业计划提供资金
summary: Meta is investing $115 million to stand up a new training program for data center technician jobs, as the social ‌media giant races to build the infrastructure to power its AI ambitions.
summary_zh: Meta 正在投资 1.15 亿美元，为数据中心技术人员岗位设立新的培训计划，这家社交媒体巨头正在竞相建设基础设施，以实现其人工智能的雄心壮志。

title: What history tells us about Marvell's upcoming S&P 500 inclusion
title_zh: 关于 Marvell 即将纳入 S&P 500 指数的历史告诉我们什么
summary: Marvell (MRVL) stock has been surging on news that it will be added to the S&P 500 (^GSPC) on Jun. 22. Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre takes a look at how stocks have historically performed in the days leading up to and following index addition.
summary_zh: Marvell (MRVL) 股票因将于 6 月 22 日被纳入标准普尔 500 指数 (^GSPC) 的消息而飙升。雅虎金融市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 分析了股票在指数纳入之前和之后几天的历史表现。

title: Why Apple's AI pivot with new Siri is raising some red flags
title_zh: 为什么苹果公司的人工智能重心与新 Siri 引发了一些危险信号
summary: Apple (AAPL) kicked off its 2026 Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) on Monday by showcasing its new AI-powered Siri, dubbed Siri AI.
summary_zh: 苹果 (AAPL) 周一拉开了 2026 年全球开发者大会 (WWDC) 的序幕，展示了全新的人工智能 Siri（称为 Siri AI）。

title: Second Facebook privacy settlement payment is coming. Who qualifies?
title_zh: Facebook第二次隐私和解付款即将到来。谁有资格？
summary: Another payment is on the way to Facebook users eligible for a cash settlement in a $725 million class-action lawsuit related to privacy issues.
summary_zh: 另一项付款正在向 Facebook 用户支付，该用户有资格在与隐私问题相关的 7.25 亿美元集体诉讼中获得现金和解。
